definitions: A large baleen whale (Balaena mysticetus) of Arctic and subarctic waters, characterized by a massive head and a highly arched jawline.
A species of whale known for its extremely long lifespan, often exceeding 100 years.
examples: The bowhead whale is well adapted to life in icy waters.
Scientists study the bowhead whale to understand longevity.
Hunting of the bowhead whale was once common.
